name: researchledger
description: Research operating system for Claude Code: 53 research-methodology skills (topic understanding through systematic literature synthesis, experiment design, analysis, academic writing, peer review and journal-audit simulation, patents/reports/slides), a /research entry point, a UserPromptSubmit hook that auto-injects per-turn research status (harness-style, no model call, backed by a cached index — not a fixed pipeline stage), plain-file conventions for tracking evidence, claims, decisions, plans and papers, and a companion `researchledger` CLI: an immutable run ledger, a deterministic RL-coded validator, claim-to-artifact tracing (forward and reverse), executable reproduction, a v1->v2 migration tool, and manuscript provenance auditing. No API key, no server — runs entirely on Claude Code's own Read/Write/Bash/WebFetch tools plus one local Python script and one local Python package.
